frozen_object.c_zero_policy: iid draws with probabilities a_i/sum_j a_j; alpha is not defined
frozen_object.forbidden_data: target arithmetic local data, Euler factors, root numbers, automorphy, target divisor or Hilbert--Polya operator
frozen_object.state: K nonnegative masses with strictly positive total mass
frozen_object.update: draw proportionally to mass, replace, and add c>=0 mass to the drawn color
frozen_object.zero_mass_policy: a zero-mass color is never drawn and the law reduces to the active face

headline: The K-color classical Polya urn closes exchangeable ordered words, the full Dirichlet-multinomial finite-time law, every factorial moment, and the Dirichlet limit.
nonclaims: No workspace novelty label is a literature-priority claim.
No finite regression prefix replaces the all-parameter proof.
No alpha parameter is assigned on the c=0 face.
No source probability identity is promoted to target arithmetic data.

route_a.decisive_obstruction: Total mass grows with source time, so no nontrivial recurrence or primitive source-orbit ledger exists.
route_a.strongest_positive: A complete finite-time and limiting probability theorem with an exact directing measure.

theorem.boundaries: c=0 is iid multinomial and uses no alpha; zero masses delete colors; K=1 is deterministic.
theorem.counts: The count vector is Dirichlet-multinomial: n!/prod n_i! times the ordered-word probability.
theorem.covariance: Var N_i=n alpha_i(A-alpha_i)(A+n)/(A^2(A+1)); Cov(N_i,N_j)=-n alpha_i alpha_j(A+n)/(A^2(A+1)).
theorem.de_finetti: The finite word law equals the Dirichlet mixture of iid categorical words; conversely this mixture reproduces the predictive urn rule.
theorem.limit: P(n) converges almost surely and in every finite Lp to a Dirichlet(alpha) vector on the active face.
theorem.marginals: Each color count is beta-binomial with parameters n, alpha_i, A-alpha_i.
theorem.ordered_words: For c>0, every word with color counts n_i has probability prod_i (alpha_i)_{n_i}/(A)_n; order is immaterial.
theorem.route_boundary: The increasing-mass chain has no source periodic-orbit clock and supplies no target arithmetic or spectral identification.
